title: Angel hierarchies of Aquinas line up with modern NHI experiences
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Angel hierarchies of Aquinas line up with modern NHI experiences, about an unknown time at an unknown place, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they were both talking about how uh the angel hierarchies of the Past St Thomas aquinus amus all that stuff you know lines up with a lot of the non-human intelligence experiences

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he heard two people he names, Karl Nell and Diana Pasulka, talking about how the ranks of angels described by Thomas Aquinas, a medieval Christian thinker, line up with many modern encounters with what they call non-human intelligence. If that is so, old religious accounts of angels and today's reports of strange beings might describe the same thing.
